## #248 live after-bounce performance receipt

Merged commit **26c684a887c809268c42aa9ceaee088569a7e1c9**; same daemon **PID 82870**, started **2026-11-19 11:44:25 AEST**. `ping` reports commit `26c684a887`. No intervening bounce.

Commands: `pij-rs --json ping`; `/bin/ps -p 82870 -o pid=,etime=,%cpu=,rss=,time=`; `just spawn-rate --seconds 20` from the canonical main checkout. A single delayed measurement waited until uptime >600 s; no fleet changes or synthetic Unknown folders were introduced.

All times below are **2026-11-19 UTC**. Missing `by_op["git.pa-watchdog-common-dir"]` is counted as **0**.

|Sample time|Daemon uptime|Placement git count|Total daemon spawns|ps %CPU|RSS KiB|CPU time|
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|01:45:07.082|00:42|0|412|51.3|214208|0:46.63|
|01:54:30.873|10:05|0|438|80.9|161280|5:42.20|
|01:54:52.125|10:27|0|438|12.1|157312|5:52.79|

**Placement count stayed 0 from boot through the >600 s retry window.** This confirms removal of the normal-layout boot burst on this live fleet. The 26 other recorded launches between the boot and ten-minute samples were `git.community` +14, `ddocs.community` +4, `ps.registration-native-process` +4, and tmux pipe detach/clear-options +2 each—not repository placement.

The 20.0 s whole-machine probe completed successfully:

- Whole machine: **185.2 new processes/s**; sampled **175.2/s**.
- Attribution lower bounds: gone before inspection **136.1/s**, other **39.1/s**; daemon children `{}`; statusline and managed Claude hooks **0.0/s** seen.
- Across the surrounding **21.260 s** paired window, **every daemon per-op counter delta was 0**, including total **438→438** and placement git **0→0**. Sampled child attribution is only a lower bound; the daemon counters supply the site-specific receipt. The machine total includes unrelated fleet work and is not attributed to #248.

**CPU remains high:** CPU time increased **10.59 s** over that paired window, approximately **49.8% of one core**. The ps endpoint readings are transient, not the interval average. **F209 / the hedgehog-Unisphere discovery issue is separately tracked; this is not attributed to #248**, and no CPU-reduction claim is made for this launch-site fix.

Proof limit: this observed fleet incurred zero placement fallback launches across the window. It does not independently exercise an intentionally Unknown layout or force a fallback-cache expiry.

Reviewer: `pij-vast-silkworm` (`role:performance/248`).
